profile.headline: FrontEnd Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Full stack developer and photographer. Most recently more focused on the front end.

-React, AWS, jenkins, c#


I enjoy traveling, DIY projects, cooking, baking sourdough bread, making music, making videos, photography, painting, development, camping, playing sports, hiking, and most importantly, learning.

positions.title: Sr. Frontend Developer
positions.description: React FrontEnd javascript developer. Building reward webapps for automotive companies.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · React · styled-components · React Hooks · JavaScript · HTML · Software as a Service (SaaS) · Gitlab

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description: 6 month contract front end software engineer for Robert Half, working at BI WORLDWIDE.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Built a new application that deals with all things integrations. 
Worked on bugs for the UI's, API's and gateway's.
  - React, Typescript, Redux, React Testing Library, Jest, .Net Core, C#, Shell Script, Jenkins

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Three different teams within this time. 
1. Sustaining Engineering/Smart Suite - Tier 3 support for Smart Suite, dealing with escalated issues whether they were configuration issues that required a deeper look, or code defects. And also worked on the Smart Suite team while they were upgraded the Smart Suite version. 
  - Linux, Oracle, Java, Hibernate, Xhtml, C++, Weblogic, PL/SQL

2. Helped build a user data migration tool that took desired information from our legacy product and delivered it to the team building out the new product directory. 
  - PL/SQL, .NET, C#, AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, 

3. Helped build a user interface to setup the integration tools built to connect the legacy system to the new product. 
  Helped build a reporting user interface which provided graphs and pdf/xcel documents of this data. 
    -React, C#, AWS, Selenium, Jest, Jenkins and more.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer/Student
positions.description:
Solo project for a Medtronic marketing team.
Full stack development of an app to show the economic value of using their product.
    o Technical: MongoDB, Express, Angular, Node, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Ajax/HTTP, Heroku,
       MongoLabs, Grunt, Git, Mongoose, HTML, CSS.


Team project for The Patchery.
Full stack development of an app allowing testers to sign up as volunteers to test products. It
organizes all testers, products, and campaigns, while automating processes.
    o Technical: MongoDB, Express, Angular, Node, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, jQuery, Passport,
       ng-file-upload, Sendgrid, Facebook OAuth.

positions.title: Research and Evaluation
positions.description: Conduct quantitative and qualitative field research through interviews, focus groups, and surveys. Analyze and evaluate the research through coding and gathering information through programs like Dedoose. Create documents to input data to then be used by research programs. I also am the English-Spanish translator for certain projects

positions.title: Maker Corps Intern
positions.description: Learning about the Maker movement and implementing that by creating new activities that incorporate "Making" and science learning. I do research, documentation, experimentation, work with a wide variety of new tools, facilitation, community outreach, blog, and organize.

positions.title: Executive Team Leader
positions.description: Lead my own team in both assets protection and store merchandising. Lead the entire store as the store's  team leader on duty a few times a week, being in charge of everything and all teams in the store.

positions.title: Marketing/Sales Intern
positions.description: Product launch planning and execution for ByME mobile app. Local and out of state client sales and relations. Market research for future products

positions.title: Video Production Intern
positions.description: Create promotional videos and game recaps with and for the team. I recorded all footage, edited, and put all material on their website. Working with Final Cut, Live Type, Photoshop, and Adobe After Effects.

educations.fieldOfStudy: MEAN stack development with Javascript as the base

volunteerExperiences.description:
I am a mentor for a group of students going through the programming bootcamp at Prime. We talk about life after the bootcamp, programming problems, ways to keep learning and improve and much more. 

I have also helped out at free community outreach classes teaching some basics of html and css

I made videos, took pictures, translated, and worked on promotional materials to bring in more volunteers. We were building an earthship for a Non-profit that was aiming to become the eartship construction company of Latin America. Their earnings go towards building an auto-sustainable school in Guatemala.
